correctness.rationale: Dihedral symmetry reduces x to a reference edge x(a)=(1−da,r+da), r=√2−1,d=2−√2. On E0 sum norm 2 exceeds difference norm. On E2 x±y reduce after norm symmetry to N(√2±d(a−b),w), |w|≤d; strict monotonicity in the first coordinate yields F=0 iff a=b, exactly y=Rx. E3 reverses signs with one shared endpoint. Central symmetry gives E4...E7 and y=−Rx. Explicit x±Rx have coordinate √2 and another coordinate magnitude ≤d, so N=√2. Whole continuum classified by inequalities, not grid.
